text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O is set to run three 1200 
meter races. She's training hard every 
day.

But she doesn't want to run just short 
distances. The next race after these 
three, she might not be convinced anymore.

While I was thinking about this, I was 
walking around campus and came across…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good for you, Ms. Flower! The doctor even 
complimented you on your quick recovery!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Ms. Bakushin O helping 
me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I think it would have taken me a long time 
to carry all these books by myself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for the help.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all! If I help you, it's 
inevitable that the process will speed up!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bakushin O-chan. Do you remember what 
we're gonna do tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! You wanted me to give you 
some tips on how to get started, didn't 
you!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm glad. Yeah, thanks for the help.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
And I think it's time to celebrate, don't 
you? We've all been looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ha! It's that time already!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll be right there! Now, let's be off, 
and you too, Ms. Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait a second…!

If there was a celebration, something good 
probably happened to Sakura Bakushin O. I 
decided to go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ――and, so!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That is how I, Sakura Bakushin O! Managed 
to shave five seconds off the record time 
for the quickest change from uniform to 
jersey!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Quickest change…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all very much for coming to 
celebrate this momentous occasion!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Congratulations～! (Clapclapclap!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much―!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Ms. Flower? I'm both 
fast on my feet and fast at changing 
clothes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm also the current record 
holder for fastest talker! I can't wait to 
break that one, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U, umm… That's sure great!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
But lately, you've been doing even better 
than before. I guess you could say your 
speed's been honed.

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! That's what my homeroom 
teacher said, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmm! What did you say!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
She said she appreciated how quickly you 
collected everyone's papers. She also said 
it would be even better if you could be 
more careful, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-haaa, our teacher, you say! She 
praised me that much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, I'm quite proud of 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Uh, huh, yup. I'm counting on you for your 
speed. I'll keep relying on you, class 
president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I was relied on――!!

…The contents of the congratulations were 
heartwarming, and I caught a glimpse of 
Sakura Bakushin O, so beloved by all of 
her classmates.

…Later, while walking through the school, 
I saw a pair who seemed to have finished 
partying.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I received quite a lot of 
compliments! That's me! The president 
paragon!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But, it looks like Ms. Bakushin O is 
really adored by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! As class president, it's my 
chief job to be adored!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Moreover, now I'm an upgrade from before! 
I'm the president of presidents!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
After all, thanks to my Trainer's precise 
guidance, I'm in great shape!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! Even now, I'm aiming to run 3 
short distance races so I can run in a 
long distance race!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: 3 short distance races…?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's, that's just running short 
distances, isn't it…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I think I just heard someone's heart 
leaping somewhere…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, this is still a bona-fide long 
distance. It may still be tough for you, 
Ms. Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Just follow your Trainer and you'll 
be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In fact, since working with the Trainer, 
I've been relied on more than ever.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer will absolutely make my dreams 
come true!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You believe in your Trainer a lot, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

Unexpectedly, I heard Sakura Bakushin O's 
true feelings, and my heart was filled 
with passion.

Because she believes in me, I have to lead 
her well… Down the Bakushin Road, where 
she can shine her absolute best!
